policy.split_unit: Published SequenceN directory. Physical scene identities are unavailable.
policy.dev_selection: First dev_count official train IDs ranked by SHA256 of ASCII '46:SequenceN', then ID.
policy.context: Use only physical frame numbers listed in the source's official split; require all 17 consecutive numbers.
policy.labels: Use images/<stem>.png and the native masks/<stem>.png paired by the published Mix/<stem>.mat entry.
policy.source_hashes: Official members hash the ASCII paths with LF in physical frame order. Image/mask hashes hash the ASCII hex SHA256 of each encoded PNG with LF in that order.
